name: context-compress
description: Compress tool responses and keep explicitly indexed output searchable without flooding the agent context window.

interface.shortDescription: Compress tool output before it enters context.
interface.longDescription: Run commands with concise responses, then explicitly index, fetch, or batch large data when it must remain searchable through the MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Run tests through context-compress and summarize failures.
Index this large output and search it for root causes.
Audit this session for raw tool output waste.
